false_negatives.finding: validate_saif accepts nonzero endpoint activity for frozen zero-event case 4, contradicting the source contract and runtime gate.
SAIF activity is flattened globally; an empty core.dut plus source/endpoint/commit/done toggles under a sibling assertion scope satisfies the claimed DUT-only cone gate.
The filelist validator checks only an axis path substring and leaf name. A forged /tmp/.../k8/netlist path is accepted while the checker hashes an unrelated official BASE netlist.
Old-memory rejection is one path substring rather than an exact source allowlist/module-provider gate; the same legacy module supplied from an alternate path is accepted.
The contract source_files list is not checked for completeness and reset checks are raw token searches. Omitting the memory entry and commenting out epoch payload reset still passes validate_static.
Runtime cover checks are raw token searches. Omitting the SVA entry from source_files and commenting out cp_source still passes validate_static.
UCLI command checks count comments. Moving live power capture/report to core while leaving the exact DUT commands commented still passes validate_static.

The memory sequential update is gated by mem_req_accept and known payload, not by valid===1 and ready===1. A forced accept with valid 0/X and known slot can index and mutate request state despite the no-index contract.
headline_file_count=10 is declarative only. No executable inventory enforces exactly one unique SAIF for every (k8|k1x8, case 0..4), so one file can be reused or cases omitted.

Payload-known and stability SVA have no explicit fatal action and payload X is absent from the sticky unknown counter. M1332 authors no release-log gate that would make these assertion diagnostics fail closed.

minimum_additive_successor: Bind every filelist netlist path by resolved exact path and SHA to the admitted M872/M903 object; enforce an exact compilation-unit allowlist and reject duplicate module providers.
Require the exact complete source_files key set rather than trusting a caller-supplied subset; analyze active syntax rather than comments/tokens.
Gate memory state updates on known valid, ready and accept equality; fault without indexing on every illegal handshake and add response-hold/protocol attacks.
Parse SAIF hierarchy and activity within the exact core.dut subtree only, reject sibling/wrapper/test-memory activity, and require case-4 endpoint TC/count exactly zero.
Add a batch result manifest requiring ten distinct files and the complete unique Cartesian product of two headline axes by five cases, with exact cycle/duration anchors.

Make runtime payload/stability assertion failures explicitly fatal or consume a sealed assertion-failure count in the result extractor; bind source/endpoint/commit/stall/done cover counts and watchdog terminal exactly.
Parse active UCLI commands and require the only capture/report scope to be core.dut; comments must not satisfy the gate.

authorization.next_gate: A new additive source successor must pass a different-author receipt-blind mutation hammer before any VCS release is authored.
